title: Answer key uses a broken discount-period convention: the stub period is halved but later periods still step by +1
evidence: Input Operating Model!J34 = 0.75. Cover!G6 puts the end of historicals at 2025-09-29, so 0.75 of FY2026E is left, and K34:S34 = prior+1 gives 0.75, 1.75 … 9.75 (end-of-period). The GT changes J34 to '=0.75/2' (0.375) but keeps K34 '=J34+1', so it produces 0.375, 1.375 … 9.375. That is neither end-of-period (0.75, 1.75…) nor a correct mid-period convention (0.375, 1.25, 2.25…): every period after the stub is off by 0.125. The GT also discounts the exit-multiple terminal value at S34 = 9.375 (DCF!E7 '=E6/(1+E4)^'Operating Model'!S34') when it should be the end of year (9.75). Every row-35 PV, DCF!E3/E7/E9/E13/E16/E22, J3/J7/J9/J13/J16/J22, Cover!G10, DCF M12/M30 and PTA R22 are modification cells that depend on this. The single verifier (weight 1, all-or-nothing) needs every modification cell within 1%, so an agent that leaves the correct 0.75 schedule, or applies a proper mid-year convention, scores 0. Nothing in the materials asks for a mid-year convention.
